test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 25 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Reni Village in Garhwal was known for what environmental movement in 1970?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chipko Movement.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Chipko development began in the mid-1970** in the Garhwal Himalayas of Uttarakhand (the then U.P)**. The milestone occasion occurred on **26 March 1974.**
 
• When a gathering of labourer ladies of Reni town in Chamoli locale of Uttarakhand acted to forestall the cutting of trees and recover their customary timberland freedoms.
 
• **Gaura Devi drove 27** of the town ladies to the site and faced the lumberjacks.
 
• The Chipko development started from an episode in a far-off town called **Reni in Garhwal, **high-up in the Himalayas during the mid-1970s**.**
 
• **Sunderlal Bahuguna** a preservationist was the main impetus behind the unbelievable Chipko development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Save Silent Valley was a social development focused on the security of Silent valley, an evergreen tropical backwoods in the **Palakkad **region of Kerala, India.
 
• Wilderness** Bachao Andolan **was begun in 1982 in the **Singbhum locale of Jharkhand(then Bihar)**.
 
• The **Appiko **Movement was privately known as **"Appiko Chaluvali".**
 
• Local people embraced the trees which were to be cut by project workers of the woodland division.
 
• The** Appiko **development utilized different procedures to bring issues to light, for example, foot walks in the inside woodland, slide shows, society moves, road plays and so on.
 
• '**Appiko**' signifies '**embrace**'. To develop and safeguard trees and to forestall their obliteration, this development was begun **in Karnataka.02-Sept-2020.**
